issue: Whether the wider climate/social policy environment is one regime or several nested/overlapping regimes
evidence_available: Regulation cites multiple EU instruments and amends Regulation 2021/1060
reason_for_uncertainty: Single frozen instrument does not provide enough evidence to set boundaries across other instruments and institutions
handling: Defer regime inference; treat those references as interfaces only
confidence_effect: No effect on bounded Fund architecture

issue: Whether statutory plan consultation monitoring internal controls and reporting operate effectively
evidence_available: Legal duties in Arts. 5 21 24 and Annex III
reason_for_uncertainty: Legal text establishes assignments and procedures but not performance
handling: Restrict claims to formal legal design
confidence_effect: Does not lower confidence in text-based assignments; prohibits operational claims

issue: How much practical choice Member States and Commission exercise within criteria and plan approval/payment processes
evidence_available: Open-textured assessment criteria and bounded choices in Arts. 4 8 11 16 20
reason_for_uncertainty: Text assigns evaluative judgment but cannot establish its practical range or use

issue: How often support is routed through public/private entities and whether such entities exercise consequential gatekeeping
evidence_available: Art. 9 permits intermediated support and requires pass-through safeguards
reason_for_uncertainty: Optional legal route without evidence on uptake or structural necessity

issue: Relative weight of Commission monitoring Parliament dialogue audit rights and national control arrangements
reason_for_uncertainty: Forums and powers differ in object and consequence and do not form a single undifferentiated chain
handling: Retain separately typed relationships; aggregate cautiously at control configuration level
confidence_effect: Medium-high for configuration; no single accountability ranking

issue: Whether the configuration merits the label control-intensive compared with other legal architectures
evidence_available: Multiple required controls data duties audit access reporting and remedial powers within this Regulation
reason_for_uncertainty: Comparative baseline absent and qualitative descriptor is inferential
handling: Use bounded descriptive label tied to enumerated design features; do not treat as a comparative score

issue: Whether legally relevant actors or actor categories remain ambiguous for the bounded Fund-design claim
evidence_available: Articles 1–27 and Annex III assign roles to the Commission Member States stakeholders recipients and oversight bodies
reason_for_uncertainty: The frozen instrument identifies the actor categories needed for the current claim; national implementation instances are outside scope
handling: No unresolved actor ambiguity is material to this case; do not infer unnamed national actors

issue: Whether the legally assigned actions remain ambiguous for the bounded Fund-design claim
evidence_available: Operative provisions identify submission assessment implementation monitoring reporting payment audit and remedial actions
reason_for_uncertainty: The current claims track these textual actions and do not depend on an unresolved action classification
handling: No unresolved action ambiguity is material to the current claim

issue: Whether legal modality remains ambiguous for the coded duties and permissions
evidence_available: The Regulation distinguishes mandatory duties and permissions through its operative provisions
reason_for_uncertainty: The registers preserve mandatory versus optional assignments where relevant
handling: No unresolved modality ambiguity is material to the current claim

issue: Whether the legal conditions attached to payment and optional delivery remain ambiguous
evidence_available: Articles 7 9 17 and 20 state the relevant performance and pass-through conditions
reason_for_uncertainty: The claim records payment conditions and optional delivery without inferring practical satisfaction
handling: No unresolved legal-condition ambiguity is material; performance in practice remains covered by U02

issue: Whether separate provisions can be linked into the Plan funding and control configurations
reason_for_uncertainty: Configuration membership and the direct-management/national-implementation relation require cross-provision interpretation
handling: Keep links explicit in relation/configuration registers and traceability matrix; retain medium-high confidence at architecture level
confidence_effect: Residual inferential uncertainty is represented in U06

issue: Whether the analysis should stop at configuration level or proceed to a bounded Fund-specific architecture claim
evidence_available: Three linked configurations include required Plan gateway consequential Commission decisions performance conditions and control/remedial stages
reason_for_uncertainty: The legal sequence and consequences support the bounded architecture claim while the broader regime lacks source coverage
handling: Stop at A01 and defer regime/operational classification; no further higher-order claim is warranted
confidence_effect: Medium-high for the bounded architecture; broader claims deferred
